svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · preview-only · phone
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift) in its .previewOnly state (2026-09-26, plan §10 + §16; the Blends line and the screen's numbers added by the lead the same day): the project's originals are on PicPlace, not on this device — here because free up space removed them (Settings or the card's Remove…), the same card a project pulled as a preview shows. The glyph is not a cloud: statusGlyph(for: .previewOnly) answers the asset glyph, the grey camera.fill (#AEAEB2 — the originals on PicPlace, can come down; green would mean here), or the green layers with the title "Blends here" when a blend is still on the device. The title "Preview only" (title(for:)); the caption "The originals are on PicPlace · 20 files · 76,3 MB" (caption(for:): PicPlace's own list once read, else the record's count), lineLimit 2 — beside the action (116 pt) the HStack leaves its text ≈177 pt, so it wraps as "The originals are on PicPlace ·" / "20 files · 76,3 MB" (CoreText at 11.5 pt, not photographed); the action "Download originals" (actionButton: originalsDownloadKinds — the source, and a Photo capture's stack with it), 12.5 pt semibold accent, "Preview only" and disabled when nothing can be fetched. No Originals line (isPreviewOnly: the header's button is that line) and, on a Photo capture, no Blends line; an interval or video project whose blends are on PicPlace adds one — drawn here: "Blends · On PicPlace · 1 blend · 410 KB · Download" under a divider at 66. Then the small print (notes): the last removal's outcome, RemovalOutcome.caption — "Removed 20 files · 76,3 MB from this iPhone" — straight under the Blends line (no top padding when there are lines; 12 pt when there are none). No Also on row: that belongs to the synced state. Demo data: project-detail.interval.preview.portrait.svg's 20-photo interval (76,3 MB) and its one blend.

g.text: Removed 20 files · 76,3 MB from this iPhone
